description: This file contains unit tests for the AdoNetStreamFailureHandler class, specifically testing its behavior against different relational databases like SQL Server, MySQL, and PostgreSQL. It includes setup routines, construction tests, and failure handling tests relating to moving poisoned messages to dead letters, ensuring correct integration with database operations in streaming scenarios.
